endpoints.truth_yaml:
patch_workspaces_invoicesId_status:
  operationId: patchInvoiceStatus
  summary: Update invoice status
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260520-233247-patch.workspaces.invoices.status-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Endpoint confirmed live. PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/status
    accepts {status} body. Valid status values observed: SENT (UNSENT/PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID/VOID/OVERDUE
    also accepted per tool schema). Response is sparse on the status-update path — billing
    fields are empty; only status, id, and invoice sub-object are populated. Full invoice
    shape available via GET /invoices/{invoiceId}. Deleted test invoice after probing.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: invoiceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [status]
          properties:
            status:
              type: string
              enum: [UNSENT, SENT, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, VOID, OVERDUE]
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Invoice status updated. Response body is a sparse invoice object.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              status:
                type: string
              invoice:
                type: object
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                  status:
                    type: string
    '400':
      description: Bad request (invalid status value)
    '404':
      description: Invoice not found
endpoints.notes: Endpoint fully verified live. Status change from (new) to SENT succeeded. Response body is intentionally sparse on the /status sub-route — only status fields are populated. Confirmatory GET to /invoices/{invoiceId} returned the full invoice with status=SENT. Tool clockify_invoices_update correctly routes to PATCH /status when status param is provided.

      schema:

    - name: policyId

      required: true

      schema:
        type: string
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
            timeUnit:
              type: string
              enum: [DAYS, HOURS]
            daysPerYear:
              type: number
            requiresApproval:
              type: boolean
            autoApprove:
              type: boolean
            accrual:
              type: boolean
            negativeBalance:
              type: boolean
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Policy updated. Returns full policy object.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
              name:
                type: string
              timeUnit:
                type: string
              archived:
                type: boolean
              allowHalfDay:
                type: boolean
              allowNegativeBalance:
                type: boolean
              projectId:
                type: string
                description: Default project for automatic time-entry creation
              userGroupIds:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              userIds:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: string
              workspaceId:
                type: string
    '404':
      description: Policy not found
endpoints.notes: LIVE-OVERRIDE because the path param name differs between specs (id vs policyId). Live behavior: parameter name is irrelevant at HTTP level; both work. Recommend using 'policyId' for consistency with our codebase. Response includes undocumented fields: projectId (automatic time-entry creation project), full userGroupIds and userIds arrays. meta.changedFields is a useful addition in the response.

        schema:
          type: object
          required: [invoiced, timeEntryIds]
          properties:
            invoiced:
              type: boolean
              description: true to mark as invoiced, false to unmark
            timeEntryIds:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
              description: IDs of time entries to update

endpoints.truth_yaml:
patch_workspaces_schedulingAssignmentsRecurringId:
  operationId: patchSchedulingAssignmentRecurring
  summary: Update a recurring scheduling assignment
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260520-233247-patch.workspaces.scheduling.assignments.recurring-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Endpoint confirmed live. PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/scheduling/assignments/recurring/{assignmentId}
    accepts start, end, hoursPerDay, note, billable, includeNonWorkingDays, taskId, startTime.
    Optional seriesUpdateOption: THIS_ONE | THIS_AND_FOLLOWING | ALL (defaults to THIS_ONE).
    Response data is an ARRAY of assignment objects (even for single update).
    Period dates are timezone-shifted to UTC in response (e.g., Europe/Belgrade -2h offset applied).
    Bare /scheduling/assignments path returns 404 — only /recurring sub-path works.
    GET on /scheduling/assignments/recurring/{id} returns 405 — read not supported on individual recurring assignment.
    DELETE also uses /recurring/{id} path with optional seriesUpdateOption.
    meta.changedFields lists updated fields.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: assignmentId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: seriesUpdateOption
      in: query
      required: false
      schema:
        type: string
        enum: [THIS_ONE, THIS_AND_FOLLOWING, ALL]
        default: THIS_ONE
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          required: [start, end]
          properties:
            start:
              type: string
              description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)
            end:
              type: string
              description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339)
            hoursPerDay:
              type: number
              minimum: 0.5
              maximum: 24
            note:
              type: string
            billable:
              type: boolean
            includeNonWorkingDays:
              type: boolean
            taskId:
              type: string
            startTime:
              type: string
              description: hh:mm:ss start time
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Assignment updated. Response data is an array of assignment objects.
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                id:
                  type: string
                billable:
                  type: boolean
                hoursPerDay:
                  type: number
                note:
                  type: string
                period:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    start:
                      type: string
                      description: UTC timestamp (may be timezone-shifted from input date)
                    end:
                      type: string
                projectId:
                  type: string
                userId:
                  type: string
                recurring:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    repeat:
                      type: boolean
                    seriesId:
                      type: string
                      nullable: true
                    weeks:
                      type: integer
                workspaceId:
                  type: string
    '404':
      description: Assignment not found
endpoints.notes: Endpoint fully verified. Key findings: (1) response data is an array even for single update; (2) dates are UTC-shifted per workspace timezone; (3) bare /scheduling/assignments path is not valid — must use /recurring sub-path for all CRUD; (4) GET on individual recurring assignment returns 405. Assignment created on test project, updated (hoursPerDay 4→6, note updated), then deleted with seriesUpdateOption=ALL.
